variant.author: Rietty
variant.changelog:
# MouseLock

MouseLock keeps FFXIV in mouselook until you actually need the cursor. It pauses for chat, bags, menus, and other UI, and can also turn LMB/RMB into configurable game inputs, hotbar actions, or MouseLock controls.
variant.description: Sort your party list according to a series of rules built on top of the game's default system. Allowing you to specify based off Duty Instances and Jobs!
variant.name: Party Sort+
variant.punchline: Never worry about sorting your party again!
